entry.question: For the linear lambda=0 finite lattice, define the mass-weighted real symmetric dynamical matrix Phi=M^(-1/2) D^* D M^(-1/2). Prove self-adjointness and nonnegativity in finite dimension and state a faithful normal-mode diagonalization interface with the translation zero mode treated explicitly. Prove harmonic modal-energy conservation only from a stated harmonic-flow equation. Do not claim infinite-volume Anderson localization.
